name: tuai
description: TUAI: rice block monitoring, disease and pest detection, irrigation turns and harvest prediction from satellite imagery and computer vision.

scripts.setup: python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: cd backend && ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && ../.venv/bin/ruff check app tests
